title: Taboo list — the leak nobody names
caption:
Leaking when you sneeze is common. It's also treatable. Nearly 1 in 4 US women have a pelvic floor disorder (JAMA 2008), and pelvic floor PT works (Cochrane 2018). Ask for the referral. Send this to her.
www.aiforheratx.org
#pelvicfloor #womenshealth #incontinence #pelvicfloorpt #tabootopics

scenes.text: Priya's 38. She sneezes at school pickup, leaks a little, and has told *nobody*.

scenes.text: A pelvic floor PT tests how those muscles actually work, then retrains them with you.
phrases: Her GP wrote the referral in four minutes.
No surgery, no scans, just a physio and a plan.
In a 2018 Cochrane review, supervised training left far more women reporting a cure.

scenes.text: Eight slow lifts, three times a day, for three months. That is the protocol ACOG describes.
phrases: Tonight: 8 slow lifts, hold each about 5 seconds.
Three sets a day, and give it a full 3 months.
Then walk — WHO asks for 150 minutes a week, split however your life allows.
